key_findings_by_rq.RQ1: Relevant as a lightweight, project-applied CubeSat mission architecture pattern using M30ML/YAML docs-as-code, stakeholder needs, user stories, data structures, and generated views. It supports low-training teams but is not a general EPS behavior model.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ2: Claims reproducibility, traceability, consistency, effort reduction, integrability, reuse, and mission-assurance benefits, but evidence is mostly single-case demonstration and author observation without metrics, baseline, independent validation, or flight/test outcomes.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ3: No EPS verification procedure model prior to physical development is reported. Battery health telemetry is EPS-adjacent but not an EPS verification model.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: Architecture based on prior mission profile; adaptation to new launch/orbit profile needed.

synthesis_consistency.lineage_consistency_notes: Treat as SeaLion/M30ML/docs-as-code mission architecture paper and expanded version of an AIAA SciTech 2023 proceeding, not as the Kaslow CubeSat SysML reference-model lineage and not as an EPS-specific verification paper.

extraction_confidence.rationale: The markdown is readable, method details and limitations are explicit, and controlled coding is clear. Confidence is lower only for lifecycle/EPS-adjacent interpretation because EPS is not a paper focus.

evidence.quote: The SeaLion mission architecture and methodology is available in a publicly accessible repository.

open_researcher_notes.claims_methods_context: The paper is strongest for toolchain and process description: M30ML/YAML, file structure, derivedFrom traceability, generated diagrams/tables/manuscript, and public repository availability.
open_researcher_notes.unexpected_observations: The authors openly note human-process constraints: communication plans, student course obligations, and legacy-work capture can bottleneck architecture completion despite automation.
open_researcher_notes.evidence_caution: Do not use this paper as evidence that MBSE improves CubeSat reliability in practice; the reliability/success claim is motivational rather than demonstrated.
